tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yang zlog me'i spu gri dang gnam thog me'i skor gyi nyams len don bsdus snying por dril

ba rnam dag rdo rje dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo ya mā ri// lhag pa'i lha mchog ya mān+ta ka la// gus 'dud snying gi grogs bi shud+dha badz+ra/ po'i nyams len phyir// gshin rje gshed po'i sgrub thabs mtha' yas las// snying po mig ltar gces pa 'dir bri'o// ngag tu/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam chos dang*// tshogs mchog rnams la bdag skyabs mchi// yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la// bdag gi lus 'di 'bul bar bgyi// sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems dag bdag gis bskyed// gang gis bsod nams nyer bsags rnams// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bdag gis bsngo// 'gro 'di kun la phan mdzad phyir// dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed ces rgyud du gsungs/ gyur// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad stong pa chen po'i ngang las chos kyi rgyu snying rje chen po nyid/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rang rig hūm̐ mthing nag tu gyur pa las/ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ chad pa las/ rim bzhin nam mkha'/ rlung*/ me/ chu/ sa/ nag /ljang*/ dmar/ dkar| ser ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ las ā di kā di'i rang bzhin rdo rje pha lam las grub pa'i byang chen mchod rten 'od zer 'bar ba'i bum pa'i nang du hūm̐ las gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte ba ga'u kha sbyor gyi rnam pa'i dbus su/ pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro ba'i lte bar hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gshin rje pho mo/ ma he/ glang rgod/ pad+ma/ zla nyi gsum brtsegs kyi steng du rgyu'i yi ge hūm̐ sngon po de nyid gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa lte ba hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ a kro te ka mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/

rang nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed sku dang rtsa zhal mthing nag /zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ spyan dgu dmar zlum bsgrad pa/ snyan gong sbrul nag gis brgyan cing*/ khro gnyer shangs brdzes/ zhal gdangs/ ljags 'dril/ mche ba bcu gnyis gtsigs pa/ ā ra li'i sgra sgrog pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra ag tshom dmar ser me 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum 'khor lo/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ g.yon gsum lcags kyu/ gtun shing*/ sdigs mdzub me 'bar ba/ zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhengs pa/ khrag 'thung rigs lnga bzhugs pa'i thod skam lngas dbu brgyan pa/ spyi gtsug tu ye shes kyi khyung nag khro zhal rdo rje'i mchu can/ nyi zla'i spyan dang gnam lcags kyi rwa sprag tu nor bus brgyan cing skra kham ser 'bar ba/ rkang lag lcags kyi sder mos ro nye dkar nag bzung ba'i mgo bo zhal du gsol ba/ sgro gshog spu gri bskal me 'bar bas rdeg cing spu phran mtshon cha can ba spu'i khung rnams khyung nag me'i 'dab gshog can dang rdo rjes gtams pa la me stag 'phro ba/ thod pa nyer gcig gi mgul rgyan dang*/ mgo rlon khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu se ral khar 'phyang ba/ glang lpags kyi stod g.yogs/ zhing g.yang gi sked bcings/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ sbrul dkar khras skra sdom/ ser khras phyag gdub/ dmar khras ska rags/ ljang khus zhabs gdub/ nag khras se ral kha/ smin mtshams dang sha sul thal chen gyis byugs pa/ mkhur tshos dang dpral bar khrag chen gyi thig le/ lkog ma dang brang la zhag chen gyi zo ris dang ldan pa/ ba spu'i bu ga nas sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro zhing las kyi gshin rje bye ba dung phyur gyis bskor ba/ rang lus las sprul pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i nang du bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar gser gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi la 'jam dpal gser mdog /g.yas ral gri g.yon po ti/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ zhi mdangs ral pa'i zur phud can dar dang rat+nas brgyan pa/

zhal nang du gzigs nas bsrung ba'i las mdzad pa/ 'khor lo'i lte bar pad+ma zla nyi'i gdan la rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i mchod rten 'od zer 'phro ba'i bum pa'i nang du pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la gser gyi rdo rje yar gyi rwa lnga la rigs lnga dang*/ mar gyi rwa lnga la yum lngas mtshan pa'i lte bar ā di las zla ba/ kā di las nyi ma ga'u kha sbyor gyi nang du bh+rūṃ yig gi lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar/ e ka ya ma du ru tsakras bskor ba/ hūm̐ gi klad kor gyi nang du bla ma/ khog par rang gzhan bsrung bya'i ming yig dang pos nṛ la bskor ba/ zhabs kyu'i nang du 'khor dang nor rdzas thams cad gsal bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bsrung ba'i khro bo khro mo g.yas g.yon du zhal nang du 'gyu ba'i bsrung ba'i gur dang*/ mchod rten gyi phyi rol tu gur khang bcu gsum ni/ bh+rūṃ las gser gyi ga'u kha sbyor gyi gur kha1nga gi phyi rol du hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥlas/ rdo 2rje/ 'khor3 lo/ ri4na po che/ 5pad+ma/ rgya 6gram rnams/ sngo/ ser/ dmar/ ljang ba'i gur khang*/ de'i phyi rol du tīk+ṣ+ṇa las ral gri rno ngar can g.yon du drag tu 'khor 7ba/ de'i phyi rol du yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ e las/ rlung*/8 me/9 chu10/ sa/11 nam 12mkha'/ kham/ dmar/ dkar/ ser/ nag po'i gur khang*/ de'i phyi rol du rang sngags dang dbyangs gsal gyi phreng ba dang dgra bgegs thams cad sod ces pa'i stong pa gzhom med kyi rang sgra sgrog pa'i gur 13khang rnams su gsal ba/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rnams dkar/ dmar/ mthing ga gsum las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa srung 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha gur khang so so la so so thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/

oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes pas bzhugs su gsol/ a ti pū hoḥ zhes pas phyag 'tshal/ pra ti dzaḥhoḥ phyi mchod/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad| nang mchod/ pañca a mṛ ta/ ma hā ba ling+ta/ maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ go ro tsa na/ ba su ta/ keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi/ gsang mchod/ bo dhi tsit+ta/ bsgral mchod/ ma traṃ ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭa/ hūm̐ */ mche ba gtsigs shing bsgrims pa yi// 'jigs pa'i tshul gyi sku yis ni// gshin rje'i dregs pa 'joms mdzad pa// gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ ya ma rā dza twe no pa/ sogs yig brgya brjod/ sde brgyad bran du khol zhing snying rjes gdug pa can thams cad dus gcig la brlag nus pa dang gzhan gyi byad stems rigs sngags kyis mi tshugs pa'i mthu rtsal gyi dbang dang ldan par gyur ces nga rgyal brtan/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad bsrung ba'i gur khang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad gshin rje'i gshed po/ sgra thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra/ dran rtog thams cad 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' nyid du gdod ma nas lhun gyis grub pa'o// zhes dag pa bsgom/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dang sprul pa'i pho nya mtha' yas pa spros/ rang gzhan bsrung bya'i tshe srog nṛ'i rnam par gnod byed rnams kyis brkus shing phyogs bcu gang du khyer yang sprul pa'i pho nyas gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad/ tshe srog nṛ'i rnam pa can de 'phrog nas hūm̐ sngon po 'od 'bar ba'i rnam pa can byas te rang dang bsrung bya rnams la bstims shing*/ slar yang sprul pa'i pho nyas sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi srog snying*/ rigs drug gi tshe bsod dpal 'byor/ 'byung ba lnga'i bcud thams cad bkug ste rang nyid la bstims pas/

bkrag mdangs gzi brjid mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur cing sngags rang lhar gsal ba'i phyi rol du 'od zer g.yas bskor du yod pa/ rang gi zhal gsum dang*/ bsrung ba'i gur khang bcu gsum/ snod bcud thams cad las kyang sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar sgrog par gyur/ sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer las pho nya dpag tu med pa spros pas/ dgra gdon lha srin sde brgyad thams cad gzir zhing stobs bshig spyang mo dang po'o// rig dang rig min lha srin sde brgyad kyis bdag la ngan sbyor byas pa thams cad phyir bshig spyang mo gnyis pa'o// bdag la rbod gtong ngan sbyor zug pa thams cad phar dbyung spyang mo gsum pa'o// phas rgol gyi sbyor ba ngan pa'i gsang lam bgags spyang mo bzhi pa'o// gnod byed byad ma rbod gtong thams cad phar bzlog spyang mo lnga pa'o// mi dang mi min bsam sbyor ngan pa bshom pa thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum mnan spyang mo drug pa/ nas nam yang mi ldang ba'i las byas par gyur par dmigs/ yi ge bcu gcig pa zhal shes ltar bzla/ thun mthar/ rjes bsdu rim ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud srung 'khor dang lhar gsal ba 'od kyi rnam par bsdus te gur khang bcu gsum la thim/ gur khang rnams 'od du byas pa bdag la bstim/ bdag nyid sku lus stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar du bsdus shing nā da'ang 'od gsal stong pa chen po'i ngang du gyur/ ces mnyam par bzhag */thun mtshams ni/ slar yang rang nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed mthing nag /zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ 'khor lo dang lcags kyu thogs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhengs par gyur/ dge ba bsngo ba ni/ 'di ltar rnam par bsgoms bzlas las byung ba'i// dge ba 'di yis sems can ma lus pa// 'phags pa 'jam dpal khros pa las byung ba'i// gshin rje'i gshed po de dang 'dra bar shog

/ces smon lam gdab cing spyod lam rnam bzhi sogs la de'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bas 'jug pa gnad zab pa yin no// e ma/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i sgrub thabs skor// lcags sdig lcags 'dra yang zlog me'i spu gri// de sogs bsam gyis mi khyab mchis rnams las// zho las mar bzhin snying po gnad dril ba// bca' gzhi sogs med pa bsgom bzlas kho nas 'grub pa ni/ 'di las zab pa gzhan dag yod srid pa// kho bos gab sbas byas na lhag pa'i lha des khrel// bdag gi khong pa dral yang sha khrag las// gzhan pa cang med snying khrag 'di kho na// snying ltar gces pa rnam dag rdo rje yi// rgyun 'khyer nyams len slad du 'bri gung pa/ /sngags rgan rtag pa'i rdo rje zhes bod pas/ /mang ra'i sum mdo gzhung du bris so man ngag 'di/ /don gnyer can la stong gsum nor rdzas kyis/ /bkang ba las kyang ches cher dga' ba'i phyir/ /snying nas byin la snying nas dga' bar mdzod// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
